evidence.title: Philips Photonics VCSEL Technology for Datacenters
evidence.excerpt: Philips Photonics has completed a €27M project to advance VCSEL production. VCSEL capabilities can help unlock new solutions such as high-speed data transmission while significantly reducing the size of sensors and energy consumption in datacenters.

evidence.title: CommScope Fiber Connectors for Data Centers
evidence.excerpt: CommScope offers a variety of low-loss LC, SC, SN and MPO fiber optic connectors that deliver superior mechanical and optical performance. CommScope's fiber optic connectivity solutions help data centers evolve reliably and smoothly for GPU and switch connections.

evidence.title: TE Connectivity AdrenaLINE Catapult Connectors for AI
evidence.excerpt: TE's 224 Gbps AdrenaLINE Catapult near-chip connector enables architectures for over-the-board pluggable I/O ports and cabled backplane systems for AI accelerator applications with optimized insertion loss and return loss.

evidence.title: Coherent 200-Gbps Electro-Absorption Modulated Laser
evidence.excerpt: Coherent's 200-Gbps Electro-Absorption Modulated Laser (EML) enables next-generation transceiver modules consisting of a phase-shifter DFB laser, a high-bandwidth electro-absorption modulator integrated on an Indium Phosphide chip.

evidence.title: Mitsubishi Electric DFB-CAN Laser for Digital Coherent Communications
evidence.excerpt: Mitsubishi Electric to Ship Samples of DFB-CAN with Built-in Wavelength Monitor for Digital Coherent Information & Communication Systems for high-speed optical transmission in datacenters.

evidence.title: Sumitomo Electric EML for 800G AI Optical Transmissions
evidence.excerpt: Sumitomo Electric developed 53 GBaud Electro-Absorption Modulator Integrated Lasers (EML) enabling next-generation transceiver modules with distributed feedback laser diodes for 400 Gbit/s and 800 Gbit/s datacenter optical transmission systems.

evidence.title: Motivair Coolant Distribution Unit for AI Datacenters
evidence.excerpt: Motivair's Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs) form the cornerstone of efficient liquid cooling systems designed for today's AI-driven data centers, scaling from 105 kilowatts to 2.5 megawatts with advanced redundancy and fault-tolerant architectures.

evidence.title: Hyperdimensional Photonic AI Accelerator with Si3N4 Microcomb Laser
evidence.excerpt: A 262 TOPS Hyperdimensional Photonic AI Accelerator powered by a Si3N4 microcomb laser array demonstrates laser-array processors for vastly improved AI computing efficiency in datacenter applications.

evidence.title: Wolfspeed SiC and GaN Materials for RF and Power Devices
evidence.excerpt: Wolfspeed produces GaN, AlxGa1-xN and Al1-yInyN epitaxial layers on SiC substrates, with the industry's broadest range of SiC and GaN materials providing n-type SiC substrates for high-performance semiconductor applications.

evidence.title: Sumitomo Electric Compound Semiconductor Epitaxial Wafers
evidence.excerpt: Sumitomo Electric Semiconductor Materials supplies compound semiconductor substrates (GaAs and InP wafers) for electronics manufacturing. The company is actively advancing development of 6-inch GaN substrates and high quality SiC epitaxial wafers called EpiEra™.

evidence.title: WIN Semiconductors GaAs Specialty Foundry Services
evidence.excerpt: WIN Semiconductors has established three advanced GaAs wafer fabs providing dedicated foundry services. Using state of the art GaAs technology, WIN supplies HBT and pHEMT MMIC fabrication services with annual capacity exceeding half a million wafers and 65% market share among compound semiconductor foundries.

evidence.title: Astera Labs Aries PCIe Retimer for AI Infrastructure
evidence.excerpt: Astera Labs' Aries family covers high-speed PCIe/CXL retimers delivering robust, low-power PCIe 6.x and CXL 3.x connectivity between next generation GPUs, accelerators, CPUs, NICs, and CXL memory controllers in data-centric systems.

evidence.title: Credo Semiconductor Toucan PCIe Retimer Solutions
evidence.excerpt: Credo's Toucan line of PCIe Gen6 retimers delivers 40dB reach and sub 7ns latency enabling high-speed connectivity for AI accelerators and GPU-to-GPU communication in datacenter systems.

evidence.title: Credo ZeroFlap Active Electrical Cable for AI Infrastructure
evidence.excerpt: Credo's Active Electrical Cables (AECs) are copper cables with purpose-built DSP and Retimer chips enabling zero link flaps for AI clusters, delivering lossless 800G connectivity for datacenter applications.

evidence.title: Astera Labs Scorpio Smart Fabric Switch for AI
evidence.excerpt: Astera Labs' Scorpio Smart Fabric Switch portfolio delivers maximum system utilization for AI use cases, with Scorpio X-Series 320 Lane Smart Fabric Switch engineered to support large scale-up GPU clusters with minimal latency.

evidence.title: AGC EUV Mask Blanks for Semiconductor Lithography
evidence.excerpt: AGC produces EUVL mask blanks consisting of low-thermal expansion glass substrates with alternating layers of molybdenum and silicon, with a ruthenium capping layer. AGC commands over 59% of the global EUVL mask blank market as the world's only EUVL mask blank manufacturer capable of handling all processes from glass materials to coating.

evidence.title: Merck AZ 910 Remover for RDL Photoresist in Semiconductor Packaging
evidence.excerpt: Merck's AZ 910 Remover is a formulated NMP-free chemistry designed for faster dissolution of photoresist patterns. Common applications include metal lift-off, RDL (redistribution layer), copper electroplating, and positive and negative resist removal in semiconductor manufacturing.

evidence.title: Merck Expands CMP Slurry Production in Korea
evidence.excerpt: In February 2022, Merck Korea completed construction of a semiconductor CMP slurry production facility, enabling direct local production of CMP slurry that is used in chemical mechanical polishing of semiconductor wafers.

evidence.title: Entegris CMP Slurry Solutions for Semiconductor Manufacturing
evidence.excerpt: Entegris is a market leader in the design and production of CMP slurries with high-performance Tungsten CMP polishing slurries (Semi-Sperse and WIN) and Dielectric CMP polishing slurries (iDIEL) for polishing semiconductor wafers.

evidence.title: Hanmi Semiconductor TCB Bonders for HBM Manufacturing
evidence.excerpt: Hanmi Semiconductor has the highest market share in the HBM TCB bonder market. TC bonders employ thermal compression to bond and stack chips on processed wafers for AI accelerator packaging, significantly influencing HBM yield.

evidence.title: ASMPT FIREBIRD TCB Thermo-Compression Bonding System
evidence.excerpt: ASMPT's FIREBIRD TCB achieves angular accuracy of ±0.01° for larger dies and ±0.05° for smaller ones with co-planarity of 3 μm over 33 mm, making it ideal for HBM and AI accelerator packaging applications.
